title: Class Selector
body:
Matches every element carrying a given `class` attribute. Written with a leading dot. ```html
abc

cde

``` ```css .box { border: 1px solid black; } ``` Classes are reusable and an element can have several of them (`class="box orange"`), which is why they are the normal hook for styling. Toggling one from JavaScript with `node.classList.add` / `.toggle` is how [[Modifying Documents]] changes appearance without touching inline styles. Contrast [[ID Selector]]. See [[CSS Selectors]].
